title: Indie and pay-what-you-want
blurb: The middle of the spectrum: a price the author sets, a price you choose, or a few euros for a book no publisher would have taken.

items.d: Books in progress sold at a sliding price, with free updates as the author writes.
The oldest independent ebook shop, with a large free section.
Where zines, art books and manuals are sold directly by the people who made them.
A storefront for ebooks and courses, with no monthly fee for the seller.
One upload that reaches the big ebook shops, for authors who skip the agent.
Games and the zines around them, sold at a price the buyer can raise.
